notes.title: DEFINITE UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GCKWwWE.png[/img]

Prior to the release of [i]Lalli,[/i] our upcoming hack-n-slash set in the world of Sotidrokhima, we decided to upload the final definitive update to The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga.
No new updates are in sight after this; however if any more bugs are found by players we will obviously look into it.

Definitive Update contents:
[list]
[*]ALL cutscenes now skippable (including narrated ones)
[*]some levels slightly decreased in size so enemies easier to find
[*]more enemies added to some levels
[*]game can now be quit in Pause menu as well
[/list]
